thread:
incident-bot: PAGING: Elevated 5xx rate observed for inference-gateway (svc=inference-gateway, region=us-west). Paging on-call: @maria_sre_oncall :rotating_light:

maria_sre_oncall: acked. I'm on it. Pulling graphs and logs now.

aj_platform: seeing spike ~11:12 UTC, 5xx went from ~0.2% to ~18% over 3m. Latency also up.

carla_runtime: quick snapshot from observability:
```
metric: http_responses{code=5xx,service="inference-gateway"} rate: 18% at 11:13:27 UTC
logs (sample): "upstream reset: connection failure" "upstream response: 503 upstream connect error"
```

maria_sre_oncall: thanks. Can someone check Envoy admin / config dump? suspect route/retry/circuit-breaker change.

carla_runtime: pulling config dump from one of the gateways now:
```
curl -sS http://10.2.4.12:9901/config_dump | jq '.configs[] | select(.name=="envoy.config.route.v3.RouteConfiguration")'
```
Found recent patch at 11:10 UTC: retry_policy added to route "/v1/generate" with num_retries=3 and per_try_timeout=3s. Also cluster circuit_breakers: max_connections lowered from 3000 -> 300.

sam_lead: that lines up with deploy window 11:08 — looks like a control-plane rollout that modified both route retry and cb thresholds. Might be overload + retry amplification.

aj_platform: logs show retry-after-retry causing upstream saturation. Example access log tail:
```
[11:12:34] "POST /v1/generate" 200ms 503 - "upstream_reset" attempts=3
[11:12:35] "POST /v1/generate" 1s 503 - "upstream_reset" attempts=3
```

maria_sre_oncall: mitigation plan: 1) revert retry policy on route -> set num_retries=0; 2) restore circuit_breaker max_connections to 3000; 3) if needed, route traffic to fallback pool (model-fallback) with lower QPS. I'll run changes via control plane.

carla_runtime: to revert retry quickly, you can POST a patch to control-plane API (example):
```
curl -u admin:REDACTED -X POST https://control-plane.internal/api/routes/patch \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{"route":"/v1/generate","patch":{"retry_policy":null}}'
```
Note: control plane will push config to Envoy xDS; expect config propagation ~10-20s per region.

maria_sre_oncall: applying patch now.

ops-bot: Deploy patch request accepted: patch_id=patch-2026-03-15-1114. Rolling to us-west clusters.

maria_sre_oncall: also bumping cb thresholds via cluster-patch:
```
curl -u admin:REDACTED -X POST https://control-plane.internal/api/clusters/patch -d '{"cluster":"inference-upstream","circuit_breakers":{"max_connections":3000}}'
```

aj_platform: seeing config push acked by Envoy: config_dump now shows retry_policy null for route "/v1/generate". cluster max_connections=3000 again.

carla_runtime: metrics update: 11:17 UTC -> 5xx fallen from 18% to 6% within ~4m after pushes. Latency down.

maria_sre_oncall: great. Keep monitoring for recurrence and any noisy clients. I'm also enabling rate-limiting at edge for the route to prevent sudden bursts while we continue.

sam_lead: good call. Can we identify which control-plane actor applied the original change at 11:08? Need audit for postmortem.

carla_runtime: audit logs show patch submitted by service account `deploy-bot` from pipeline `routing-rollout` at 11:08 with PR #4823. It contained both retry_policy and cb change.

maria_sre_oncall: immediate next actions:
- rollback retry (done)
- restore cb (done)
- enable edge rate-limit 500 r/s for /v1/generate (in flight)
- keep canary traffic on fallback pool for 15m

ops-bot: edge rate-limit policy applied to ingress-edge in us-west: policy-id=rl-2026-03-15-11-18.

aj_platform: customer impact: internal alerting flagged 7 customer-facing anomalies between 11:10-11:16. I ran a quick query: approx 2.3k requests returned 5xx across all regions; estimated affected customers ~12 (mostly high throughput accounts). Noted one support ticket already created.

sam_lead: notify support + account execs for the 12 customers. Carla, can you collect example request IDs and sample logs for tickets?

carla_runtime: collecting. sample request-id: rq_7b2c9a, upstream_error: "upstream connect error or disconnect/reset before headers". Attaching two more samples in the ticket.

maria_sre_oncall: monitoring window 15m. If 5xx stays <1% and latency stable, we'll set incident to mitigated and open postmortem.

aj_platform: 11:27 UTC metrics: 5xx at 0.9%, latency P95 back to baseline. Looks stable.

maria_sre_oncall: handing off to @aj_platform for remainder of monitoring and postmortem. I need to respond to the exec thread. Summary for handoff:
- root cause: route + cluster config change in rollout (retry_policy added + aggressive cb reduction) -> retry amplification -> upstream saturation -> 5xx spike
- mitigations executed: removed retry_policy, restored cb max_connections, applied ingress rate-limit, routed canary traffic to fallback pool
- impact: ~2.3k 5xx across 12 customers between 11:10-11:16, degraded latency during spike
- next steps: root-cause PR review, rollback gating for retries, automated safety check to prevent retry+low-cb combos, postmortem

aj_platform: acked. I'll monitor through 11:45 UTC and start the postmortem doc. Opening postmortem: https://wiki.internal/postmortems/2026-03-15-inference-gateway-retry-amplify (draft).

sam_lead: please include proposed action items: fail-safe validation on routing rollouts, instrumentation for retry amplification detection, and an emergency playbook to quickly disable retries.

maria_sre_oncall: escallation closed on my side. If anything toggles back, page me again. Thanks all :thumbsup:

incident-bot: INCIDENT UPDATE: mitigated -> monitoring. Created incident-1257. Severity: SEV2.

aj_platform: I'll own the postmortem and follow up with support on customer comms. Handoff complete.

ops-bot: Reminder: audit entry created for rollback actions (audit-id=aud-2026-03-15-1118).

sam_lead: thanks everyone. Closing on-call thread once postmortem link is updated and exec comms sent.

maria_sre_oncall: signing off for now.
